extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A curated dataset of Creative-Commons-licensed images paired with synthetic captions generated via a transfer-learning method called telephoning using BLIP-2, split into commercial (CommonCatalog-C) and non-commercial (CommonCatalog-NC) subsets for training text-to-image diffusion models.
extraction.license: Creative Commons licenses (CC-BY 2.0, CC-BY-SA 2.0 for CommonCatalog-C; CC-BY-NC 2.0, CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0, CC-BY 2.0, CC-BY-SA 2.0 for CommonCatalog-NC; CC-BY-NC-ND-2.0 and CC-BY-ND-2.0 for evaluation set)
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: High-resolution Creative-Commons images were re-scraped from Flickr using Flickr IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata. Images with non-derivative (ND) licenses were excluded from training data and reserved for evaluation, and the remaining images were separated into commercial and non-commercial sets. High-quality synthetic captions were generated for captionless images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Creative Commons images largely lack descriptive captions necessary to train text-to-image generative models; existing text associated with CC images rarely includes alt-text captions (around 31% had alt-text), and often consists only of image titles, camera metadata, or URLs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YFCC100M metadata and high-resolution images scraped from Flickr.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were center-cropped and resized to a maximum resolution of 512x512 pixels specifically for the BLIP-2 captioning process to reduce computational expense, while native resolutions were preserved for diffusion model training.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were re-scraped at native high resolution (exceeding 4K) from Flickr using YFCC100M IDs. Non-derivative (ND) licensed images were filtered out of the training pool. For synthetic captioning, images were center-cropped and resized to max 512x512 pixels. For model training, VAE and text encoder latents were pre-computed over the entire training dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Captions were synthetically authored using the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT-2.7B (OPT2.5B) vision-language model taking center-cropped and resized (max 512x512) images as inputs, a transfer-learning technique termed 'telephoning'.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images contain people, human faces, and recognizable public figures / celebrities (e.g., Bill Gates, Elon Musk, Kim Kardashian, Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Richard Feynman).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Provides an alternative to web-scraped datasets with unclear provenance and unresolved copyright concerns by using open-licensed CC images. By directly distributing provenanced CC images and synthetic captions, it resolves link rot and reduces vulnerability to data poisoning attacks present in URL-based web datasets like LAION.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Reduced diversity of n-grams in synthetic captions compared to human text (shown by a decrease in unique trigrams); domain shifts relative to datasets like MS COCO; lower capability/fidelity on specific categories such as human faces, general photography, and paintings.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The source YFCC100M dataset is approximately a decade old, so CC images are not as current as newer scraped sets like LAION-2B; underperforms SD2 in generating individual recognizable persons/celebrities, human faces, photography, and paintings; lower caption diversity.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, fine-tuning, and evaluating text-to-image generative models (specifically latent diffusion models).
